name: Will my insurance cover fire restoration costs?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover fire restoration costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies cover fire damage restoration, including smoke, soot, and water damage from firefighting efforts. It is important to review your specific policy details or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage limits, deductibles, and the claims process. Restoration companies can often assist with documentation for insurance claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover fire damage restoration. Check your specific policy or contact your provider for details on coverage.
